hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/instincts.js" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -f "$R/hooks/instincts.js" ]; then node "$R/hooks/instincts.js"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"keystone: instincts.js not found under the plugin root (plugin updated mid-session?) - restart this session to restore keystone hooks."}'; fi

R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/learnings.js" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -f "$R/hooks/learnings.js" ]; then node "$R/hooks/learnings.js"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"keystone: learnings.js not found under the plugin root (plugin updated mid-session?) - restart this session to restore keystone hooks."}'; fi

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"CONTEXT WAS JUST COMPACTED. Re-orient before continuing: check task progress against the users original request. If you were mid-task, read docs/handoffs/README.md (this repo continuity index) or run /pickup to resume. Note: MEMORY.md is your PERSONAL cross-project index, not this repo task-state."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Session started. If in-flight work exists in this repo, read docs/handoffs/README.md (the continuity index: newest handoff note plus any active run-state) or run /pickup to resume where you left off. docs/handoffs/README.md is this repo task-state; MEMORY.md is your personal cross-project index."}}'

R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/guard.js" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -f "$R/hooks/guard.js" ]; then node "$R/hooks/guard.js"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "🛑 [keystone] guard.js is unreachable, so the safety guard (freeze boundary + destructive-command gate) is INACTIVE. The plugin was most likely updated mid-session, which strands the version-pinned path baked into the hooks of this session. Approve only if you accept running unguarded; restart the session to restore protection."}}'; fi

R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/scan.js" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -f "$R/hooks/scan.js" ]; then node "$R/hooks/scan.js"; else S="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-nosession}"; M="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/keystone-degraded-scan-$S"; if [ ! -f "$M" ]; then : > "$M"; printf '%s' '{"systemMessage": "keystone: scan.js is unreachable, so the prompt-injection scanner is INACTIVE for the rest of this session (plugin updated mid-session?). Restart to restore it. Reported once per session."}'; fi; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format "$f";; *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.html|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) if [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f"; elif command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write "$f"; fi;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
